title: ScKillMsgSpam
description: Plugin for spamming Kill Messages in the minecraft chat. Part of the Sc (Scripted Minecraft Server Tools) series of plugins.
body:
# Functions
Starts/stops the spamming of kill messages in the chat at a chance and an interval
```
/killspam stop | interval(int/float) chance(%)
```
**Permission needed: killspam.use**

# Active developement
I, as a single dev, am constantly trying to make my plugins better and I'd love feedback on bugs, new features or even plugin suggestions. I develop plugins in my free time and I can get commisioned to make a plugin for free as long as the request isn't too complex. 

# Backstory
Originaly commisioned by the Noxa SMP, this plugin was made as a lightweight and open-source option for spamming kill messages in the minecraft chat especially in scripted servers. The plugin is part of the Sc series which is meant for scripted minecraft servers (other plugins of this series: ScNick, ScDisguise, ...).
